items.title: What's Included in the Service?
items.description: Client asks what is included
items.body:
Hi, I've attached our service booklet below for the requested service.

It outlines what's included, who we are, what sets us apart, and what you can expect from the region's highest-rated and most trusted service.

items.title: How Long Does It Take?
items.description: Client asks about service duration
items.body:
It depends, as every job is different.

Timing can vary based on the current condition of the system, overall difficulty, and property access, but most services take anywhere from 1 hour to a few hours.

We'll notify you once the job is complete and send your service results afterward.

items.title: Do I Need to Be Home?
items.description: Client asks if presence is required
items.body:
No, you do not need to be home for service.

Our system is designed to keep you fully informed from arrival to completion. You'll receive updates, service notes, photo results, and a final message once the job is finished.

items.title: How Do I Pay?
items.description: Client asks about payment methods
items.body:
We accept credit card and e-transfer.

Your invoice will be sent after service completion, typically later in the evening, by email and text with payment instructions.
items.tags: 👤 Groundsmen / Backend · 📎 Invoice sent after service

GUTTER GHOSTS
647-871-0294

items.title: Do You Offer a Guarantee? — Gutter Cleaning
items.description: Client asks about cleaning warranty
items.body:
No ongoing guarantee or warranty applies to gutter cleaning.

Once completed, we provide checklist verification and before-and-after documentation showing the quoted work was completed.

items.title: Do You Offer a Warranty? — Downspout Installations
items.description: Client asks about workmanship warranty
items.body:
Yes. Downspout installations include a 60-day workmanship warranty covering installation-related issues only.

This does not cover clogs, blockages, or weather-related damage.

items.title: Do You Offer a Warranty? — Gutter Guards
items.description: Client asks about gutter guard warranty
items.body:
Gutter guard warranty details are outlined in the package provided.

Any applicable product-related warranty must be handled through the manufacturer or supplier. Debris buildup after installation is not covered.
items.tags: 👤 Groundsmen / Backend · 📎 Gutter guard booklet / package

items.title: Do You Cover Leak Concerns?
items.description: Client asks about leak-related follow-up
items.body:
Yes. Leak-related service concerns are covered for 14 days after completion.

Please send photos or video of the issue so our team can review it.

items.title: What Is a Complimentary Rapid Gutter Cleaning?
items.description: Client asks how rapid clean works and when to use it
items.body:
A complimentary rapid gutter cleaning is a quick maintenance service of up to 30 minutes intended for light upkeep only.

To redeem it, you must notify GUTTER GHOSTS before October 1 and provide proof that it was included with your service.

After October 1, it can no longer be redeemed.

items.title: Answer the Call
items.description: Call sequence · step 1
items.body:
👻 You say
"GUTTER GHOSTS, _________ speaking — how can I help you today?"
Fill in your name. Warm, confident, direct. Let them speak first.

items.title: Listen & Acknowledge
items.description: Call sequence · step 2
items.body:
Three common client openings — acknowledge, assure, redirect:
If they ask if you offer a service
"Absolutely — that's one of our core services. You've called the right place. Let me grab a few details and we'll get your quote started right away."
If they ask for a quote
"Perfect — we handle [service] all the time across Durham Region. I'll take down your info and have our quoting specialist Sarah get that sent over to you today."
If they describe a problem
"That's something we deal with regularly — no worries at all. We'll get one of our crew out to sort it. Let me grab your details and we'll take care of it from here."

items.title: Ask How They Heard About Us
items.description: Call sequence · step 3
items.body:
👻 You say
"Quick one — how did you hear about us?"
Record in Jobber → client record → Lead Source field immediately after the call.
Build-off responses by source
Google →
"You must have read some of our reviews — 4.9 stars, 155+ five-stars. You're in great hands!"
Referral →
"Who told you about us? Love hearing that — we'll make sure you get the same experience."
Neighbour →
"We're always in the area — glad you caught us! Looks like your neighbours have good taste."
Social →
"Great — we put a lot into showing the real process. Happy it connected!"
Door hanger →
"Perfect timing — we were just in your neighbourhood. You're already on our radar!"

items.title: Tell Them About the Service
items.description: Call sequence · step 4
items.body:
👻 Your floor — don't rush this part
"So here's how we work — we're not your average crew. Every job comes with real-time updates, before-and-after documentation, and you'll know exactly who's showing up before they arrive. We do [service] all across Durham Region and we're the highest-rated service in the area for a reason."
Then add
"I'll send our service booklet by text — it walks through everything start to finish. No surprises, no hidden fees."

items.title: Address the Service Request
items.description: Call sequence · step 5
items.body:
👻 You say
"To make sure we quote you accurately — just a couple of quick questions about the property."
Gutter Clean
How many storeys? Heavy tree coverage? Last time cleaned?
Window Clean
Approx. number of windows? Any hard-to-reach areas or skylights?
Gutter Guard
Same as clean + any existing guards to remove?
Downspout
Where's the issue? Detached, crushed, missing, or needs extension?
Holiday Lights
Which areas? Roofline, windows, trees? Colour preferences?
System Inspection
Any known issues? Pre-winter or post-storm check?

items.title: Lead-to-booking sequence
items.body:
1. New inquiry: confirm name, address, phone, email, and display preferences.
2. Prepare mock-up and send approved service information.
3. Josh/Sarah issues the official quote through Jobber.
4. After 2–3 days: send a short nudge and answer questions.
5. Quote approved: arrange the 50% deposit; confirm the service date once received.
6. Day before installation: send preparation and arrival details.
7. After installation: document results and arrange the remaining 50% payment.
8. Handle seasonal maintenance, takedown, and storage.

items.title: Display discovery questions
items.body:
1. What is your property address?
2. Which rooflines or areas would you like lit?
3. Warm white, a colour, or an alternating pattern?
4. Would you like trees, shrubs, pillars, or railings included?
5. Do you have a budget range you would like us to design around?
6. Is there an accessible outdoor power outlet?
7. What installation timing works for you?
8. What is your preferred phone number and email?
9. What questions can we answer before preparing your design?

items.title: Service Q&A
items.body:
What is included?
Custom design, installation, seasonal maintenance, takedown, and storage.

Who owns the lighting?
GUTTER GHOSTS retains the lighting and stores it for the next season.

What if part of the display stops working?
Contact us with a photo and a description; we prioritize holiday lighting service concerns.

How is payment arranged?
50% deposit to secure the date and 50% after installation.

Where is the official quote?
Through Jobber. Use the approved quote for scope and pricing.

items.title: Realistic holiday lighting mock-up
items.body:
Edit the uploaded home photo into a realistic holiday lighting mock-up. Preserve the exact architecture, windows, landscaping, perspective, and framing.

Use realistic, correctly scaled commercial C9 bulbs pointed downwards along the selected gutters and shingle edges. Colour/pattern: [COLOUR]. Additional areas: [AREAS]. Tree/shrub lighting: [TREE DETAILS].

Later evening with darker skies, a winter setting, and light snowfall. Keep the holiday lights the focal point with a soft, realistic glow. Do not enlarge the bulbs or add unrequested decorations. Preserve all unselected parts of the home.
